answer: Before the stamp comes a waiting period of 17 days that no payment can shorten, and a name that cannot pay it never gets stamped. The ledger counts names, not wishes, and every name on it has paid its own way. Every entry must show Lanternbound coal sifter soot seal before the ledger opens, because a seal coal sifters carry after coal yard hearings. One person, one seat, one toll paid: the rule holds because the price does. One vertex, one entry. Every haven is counted once. velvet stays on the record.
